translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: A Yave, wa lusambulu luama,
dimba yamikina kuama mu diambu di kiadi
mu kikhuikizi kiaku ayi mu busonga buaku,
yiza wutsadisa.
Kadi nata kisadi kiaku ku tsambusu ;
bila kadi mutu wumosi widi moyo widi wusonga va ntualꞌaku.
Bila mbeni wulembo ndandakana,
wulembo ndiatidila va tsi ;
niandi wukuphuandisanga mu bibuangu bidi tombi
banga batu bobo bafua thama.
Buna pheve ama yeka suka-suka mu khati ama ;
ntimꞌama weka mona tsisi mu khati ama.
Ndilembo tebukila moyo bilumbu bivioka.
Ndinyindulanga mavanga maku moso
ayi fiongunina mavanga ma mioko miaku.
Ndinonuna mioko miama kuidi ngeyo.
Muelꞌama widi phuila mu kumona
banga ntoto wu yuma, bu wididi phuila nlangu.
Wuphani mvutu mu nsualu, a Yave
pheve ama yilembo yami.
Kadi kutsuekila zizi kiaku
bila ndieka dedakana banga bobo bankuendanga ku dibulu.
Bika nsuka wundatina mambu ma luzolo luaku lu ngolo ;
bila nditula diana diama mu ngeyo.
Wumbonisa nzila yoyi mfueti kuendila
bila kuidi ngeyo ndimvumbula muelꞌama.
Wukhula mu bambeni ziama, a Yave ;
bila ndikukisuekanga mu ngeyo.
Wundonga mu vanga luzolo luaku
bila ngeyo Nzambi ama.
Bika pheve aku yimboti yindiatisa mu ntoto wulendumuka.
Mu diambu di dizina diaku, a Yave, tamina luzingu luama ;
mu busonga buaku, bika wuthotula mu ziphasi.
Mu luzolo luaku lu ngolo, kanga bambeni ziama ;
bunga babo bobo beti kundenda, bila ndidi kisadi kiaku.
